summary.name: tingnao.ai
summary.one_liner: A domain-for-sale page offering the tingnao.ai domain name, with purchase handled through Spaceship; the page does not describe any product.
use_cases: Making an offer on a domain for sale
Checking whether tingnao.ai is available for purchase
Finding a domain through a Spaceship listing
summary.what_it_does: The page is a sale listing for the domain tingnao.ai. Visitors fill in basic personal information to submit an offer for the domain. After submitting, they are redirected to spaceship.com to negotiate the price and pay. The page lists free transaction support, secure payments, and Spaceship reliability as selling points. It does not describe any software, recording product, or features. The separate listing in hanishrao/collective-ai-tools describes it as a recording assistant, but this page does not confirm that.
notable: Domain sale listing hosted with Spaceship
Offer is submitted by form, then negotiated and paid on spaceship.com
Page does not describe any recording product
caveats: The page is only a domain sale page; it describes no software features
Price is not stated on the page and is negotiated on spaceship.com
The collective-ai-tools listing calls it a recording assistant, which this page does not support
